mapper.sql: id, account_id, token, model_id, prompt, polished, template_key, file_url, width, height, size, usage_tokens, cost_amount, duration_ms, moderation_status, status, order_id, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image_gen_record (account_id, token, model_id, prompt, polished, template_key, file_url, width, height, size, usage_tokens, cost_amount, duration_ms, moderation_status, status, order_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{token}, #{modelId}, #{prompt}, #{polished}, #{templateKey}, #{fileUrl}, #{width}, #{height}, #{size}, #{usageTokens}, #{costAmount}, #{durationMs}, #{moderationStatus}, #{status}, #{orderId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image_gen_record WHERE status = 1 AND account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE image_gen_record SET order_id = #{orderId} WHERE id = #{id} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 1 AND order_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) FROM image_gen_record WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND cost_amount IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, model_id, COUNT(*) AS gen_count, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(SUM(usage_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens FROM image_gen_record WHERE cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at), model_id ORDER BY stat_date DESC, model_id
